acceptance.given: Before Green/refactor, the frozen tests and fixtures, declared Package A production owners, and permitted write boundaries are recorded from the frozen requirements.

oracle.expected: A scope-boundary report shows that Green/refactor changes are limited to declared production owners, with no frozen test or fixture changes and no writes in excluded broad trees.
forbidden: A frozen test or fixture is changed.
A changed path falls under scripts/sc/** outside the declared production owners.
A changed path falls under docs/adr/** outside the declared ADR/index owners.
oracle.observable: The repository scope-boundary check evaluates the actual changed-path set against the frozen test/fixture manifest and declared production-owner allowlist, producing a boundary artifact.

acceptance.then: The scope-boundary check reports only declared production-owner paths changed and confirms frozen tests, fixtures, and excluded broad trees are unchanged.
acceptance.when: At Green/refactor completion, execute the repository-owned scope-boundary validation against the actual changed-path set and frozen selector/fixture manifest.

failure_intents.selector_intent: The scope-boundary test must fail when Green/refactor changes a frozen test or fixture or writes outside the declared Package A production-owner set, including broad scripts/sc/**, docs/adr/**, or .agents/skills/** paths.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate that Green/refactor changed paths stay within the declared Package A production-owner set and reject changes to frozen tests, fixtures, or excluded broad trees.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only Package A production-owner changes involved in scope enforcement; preserve frozen tests, fixtures, and unrelated repository state.

slice_hint.state_transition: The Green/refactor changed-path set is checked against the declared owner allowlist; compliant paths pass and frozen or excluded paths are rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The scope-boundary validation succeeds only when every changed path is an allowed production owner and no frozen test, fixture, or excluded broad-tree path is changed.
